description: The pie chart, titled "6 Matches," displays the distribution of data across six distinct categories, each labeled with a number from 0 to 5. The largest segment, representing category 0, accounts for 27.2% of the total (8006 instances) and is colored a dark gray-blue. The second-largest segment, for category 2, makes up 22.4% (6583 instances) and is a lighter, olive-green shade. Category 1 represents 13.8% (4046 instances) and is a medium gray. Category 3 accounts for 6.8% (2002 instances) and is a darker olive-green. Category 4 represents 6.2% (1810 instances) and is a light blue-gray. The smallest segment, category 5, accounts for 10.4% (3043 instances) and is a medium blue-gray. The percentages and corresponding values are clearly labeled within each slice, and the chart is divided into six slices of varying sizes, with the largest slice (0) being the most prominent.
